stories.title: Kalihi intersection gets new pedestrian crossing light timing
stories.summary: A signal timing change gives pedestrians a head start at the busy King Street and Gulick Avenue intersection in Kalihi.

stories.title: Man, 50, allegedly stabs another man to death at party celebrating his release from prison
stories.summary: A 50-year-old man is facing charges after authorities say he stabbed another man to death at a party celebrating his release from federal prison.

stories.title: Boy, 13, seriously injured in Kailua bicycle crash involving school bus
stories.summary: A 13-year-old boy was seriously injured after apparently riding his bicycle into the back of a school bus in Kailua, EMS said.

stories.title: Hawaii names Sanoe Damon as new state film commissioner
stories.summary: Damon worked in leadership roles on productions including “Hawaii Five-0,” “Magnum, P.I.” and “Doogie Kameāloha, M.D.

stories.title: Survey: More than half of Hawaii households struggle to afford basic needs
stories.summary: Aloha United Way found 52% of surveyed households struggle to afford necessities, up from 40% in 2024. Forty percent are considering leaving Hawaiʻi.

stories.title: Federal agents seize SIM card boxes in Kalihi capable of sending mass texts
stories.summary: Federal agents searched a Kalihi apartment building and seized equipment they say could be used to send 230,000 texts or calls per minute.

stories.title: Paris Hilton urges House to pass AI deepfake porn bill
stories.summary: Paris Hilton returned to Capitol Hill on Tuesday to urge the House to pass a bill aimed at combating nonconsensual sexually explicit deepfake images.

stories.title: Highway patrol to pay $70,000 to former Wild Orchid member in DUI arrest settlement
stories.summary: Blood work later showed Stefanie Fair was sober at the time of her arrest.

stories.title: As HPD seeks more female recruits, one found her calling during a power outage
stories.summary: She worked as a courthouse janitor and knew she had a larger calling.

stories.title: 2 Americans drown while swimming in the Bahamas, officials say
stories.summary: Two Americans died after being pulled from the water in the Bahamas, authorities said.

stories.title: Storm damage prompts partial demolition of Kepaniwai Heritage Gardens pavilions
stories.summary: Storm-damaged pavilions at Kepaniwai Heritage Gardens will undergo partial demolition from Nov. 30 to Dec. 4. The park will remain open.

stories.title: Helpers needed to grant wishes for 900 Maui County kupuna
stories.summary: Kaunoa Senior Services is asking community members to help make wishes come true for nearly 1,000 kupuna throughout Maui County this Christmas through its Giving Tree program.
